title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The lifesaving and early recovery assistance to communities programme in South Sudan implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to reduce excess morbidity and mortality of chronic crisis-affected people through equitable and dignified access to critical cross-sectoral basic services, in an aim to build resilience to shocks. The objectives of the programme is to improve access to quality emergency nutrition services; to reduce morbidity and mortality among children; to improve health, nutrition and hygiene behaviours; and to ensure the effective and timely access to basic needs in time of emergency through the provision of cash assistance. . To raise awareness on health and nutrition and to address sub-optimal feeding practices and improved healthy behaviours caregivers are reached through individual counselling and group sessions at the facility and community level. Mother and father groups were established and information sessions successfully completed following Concern’s mother and father group curriculum. The group members were assigned to share the knowledge gained with other peers within the community. Participants are also supported in vegetable gardening with tools and seeds support.
